title: Varying Delay
text: Varying delay with support for fixed delay and zero delay (direct feedthrough), 2 inputs, 1 output, {Initial output} sets Initial output; {Nominal delay} sets the nominal value of delay, {Maximum delay} sets the maximum value of time delay input, {Minimum delay} sets the minimum value of time delay input, {Fixed delays (indices)} sets the signal indices with fixed delays, {Initial buffer size} sets the initial memory allocation, {Use fixed buffer size} uses fixed-size buffer and {Pade order (for linearization)} sets the order of Pade approximation. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_2
ports.summary: Instantaneous time delay input scalar | vector

params.name: Nominal delay
params.values: Nominal value of delay 1 (default) | positive scalar | vector of positive values

params.name: Maximum delay
params.values: Maximum value of time delay input 10 (default) | nonnegative scalar | vector of nonnegative values

params.name: Minimum delay
params.values: Minimum value of time delay input 0 (default) | nonnegative scalar | vector of nonnegative values

params.name: Fixed delays (indices)
params.values: Signal indices with fixed delays [] (default) | positive scalar | vector of positive values

params.name: Pade order (for linearization)
params.values: Order of Pade approximation 0 (default) | positive integer | vector
